summary: Iteration 4 backend + frontend testing. Backend: 10 new tests in test_games_clues.py (strategy seed for 'Jot a clue', clue_captures filtering, POST /api/logs/{id}/game success/409/403/404) — all PASS. Regression: 18/18 missionboard + 8/8 streak + 15/15 AI = 51/51 total. Frontend: verified MissionTimer (start/pause/resume/reset all work — display ticked 0:02→0:03 then reset to 0:00), clue captures (Add button + Enter key both append; X removes; persists to log), reflection submit → mission-success screen with 'Play now' CTA, GamePicker shows 6 cards (word-match, memory-cards, sentence-builder, reaction-tap, dot-connect, breathing) — all required testids present, GamePlay routes render each game component with inner testids (memory-card-0..11, sentence-word-0, dot-1, breathing-start, reaction-start), after marking game played the picker shows game-picker-played-msg + cards disabled with opacity-50, ParentLogs shows '🎮 Played dot-connect · 7 pts' chip + 'Clues captured' block with quoted clue. No backend or frontend issues found.

minor.issue: score field is bound directly from user input with no clamp/validation — a negative or absurd score will be stored as-is. Probably fine for child-facing games but worth a Field(ge=0, le=999) guard.
No length/count cap. A student could submit 10k clues. Suggest cap at e.g. 20 items, each <=500 chars.

issues: Cards use opacity-50 + cursor-not-allowed but are still <button> elements with no actual disabled attribute — keyboard tab + Enter can still navigate. Consider adding disabled={true} on the button when alreadyPlayed.

action_items: (Optional) Add Pydantic constraints on GamePlayRequest.score (ge=0) and MissionLogCreate.clue_captures (max_items, max chars).
(Optional UX) Add disabled={true} on locked GamePicker cards so keyboard activation also blocks navigation, not just visual styling.
(Architecture, carry-over from iter 2/3) server.py is now ~990 lines and includes auth, missions, logs, streak, AI, game endpoint, and seed — split into routers/ modules before adding more features.
critical_code_review_comments: Strategy seed is correctly idempotent: on_startup walks existing strategy names and inserts only missing ones — restarting the backend does NOT duplicate 'Jot a clue'. Verified via test_strategies_no_duplicates which compares len(names) vs len(set(names)).

POST /api/logs/{log_id}/game has correct guards: 404 (log not found) → 403 (different student) → 409 (already played). Role guard via require_role('student') prevents parents. All four negative paths covered by tests.

clue_captures filtering ([c.strip() for c in (req.clue_captures or []) if c and c.strip()]) correctly drops empty + whitespace-only entries. Verified by sending ['x', '  ', 'y', ''] and asserting result == ['x','y'].

Game endpoint persists via $set then re-fetches; response body matches DB. No race condition for the typical single-user flow but two parallel requests from the same student could both pass the get_played check before either $set commits — would result in last-writer-wins, not a 409. Acceptable for a kid-facing game launcher; flag if game_score becomes scoring-table material.

MissionTimer is a count-up timer (not a countdown) — pause/resume preserves elapsed seconds; reset zeros it. State is local to the component and is NOT persisted (refreshing the page loses elapsed time). That matches the iter4 description (count-up working-time timer).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on iter4 features — timer, clues, success play CTA, picker (6 cards + played msg + locked styling), each game route renders, parent logs game chip + clues block

seed_data_creation: Tests register 1 throwaway TEST_-prefixed other-student per run for the 403 case; create several TEST_iter4_* missions and logs on the demo student. The demo student now has 1+ logs with game_played=true (dot-connect, breathing) which next runs of test_mark_game_played_and_409_on_second_call will not be affected by because each test creates its own fresh log on a fresh TEST_iter4 mission.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/results.xml — expect 51 passing (AI suite takes ~40s due to live Claude calls). New iter4 surfaces: (1) /api/strategies includes 'Jot a clue' 📝, idempotent; (2) MissionLog model has clue_captures (list, whitespace filtered), game_played (bool), game_key (str|null), game_score (int|null); (3) POST /api/logs/{log_id}/game (student only) returns 404/403/409 correctly. Frontend testids: mission-timer/mission-timer-toggle/mission-timer-display/mission-timer-reset, mission-detail-clues/mission-detail-clue-input/mission-detail-clue-add/mission-detail-clue-list/mission-detail-clue-<i>/mission-detail-clue-remove-<i> (list only renders when clues.length>0), mission-success/mission-success-play, game-card-<key> for all 6 games, game-picker-played-msg, game-<key> root testid on each play screen, parent-log-game-<logId>/parent-log-clues-<logId>. Reflection submit testid is 'reflection-submit' (not 'mission-detail-submit'). Submitting any reflection (even without an explicit completed status) creates a MissionLog and routes to the success screen.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found in iteration 4. All claimed features work end-to-end.
